day_shape: Sixth consecutive night of US strikes on southern Iran per CENTCOM, IRGC claims retaliatory strikes on al-Tanf and Gulf bases, tanker attack off Oman, UK charges man over Iran-linked intelligence offence, heavy regime-channel messaging.

threads.label: US sixth-night strikes on southern Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces began a sixth consecutive night of strikes at 2pm ET to degrade Iranian military capabilities, with witnesses reporting booms near Bandar Abbas and Qeshm. Iran International reported five bridges hit in southern Iran and Hormozgan medical authorities cited by Defa Press put the Khmir port bridge death toll at seven with nine wounded.

threads.label: IRGC counter-strike claims across region
threads.summary: The IRGC claimed via state media strikes on a US command centre at al-Tanf in Syria, on Al-Udeid in Qatar, on Al-Dhafra in the UAE, and on a base in Kuwait, and Qatar said its forces were still defending against air attacks. The Jerusalem Post reported Iran's army threatened a "quick and decisive" response to any US counterattack after sirens sounded in Bahrain and Kuwait.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US Marines from the 11th MEU conducted a verification boarding of M/T Wen Yao in the Gulf of Oman and that American forces had redirected three commercial vessels, disabled one and boarded another under an ongoing blockade. The UK Maritime Trade Operations authority reported a tanker attacked with an unknown projectile off Oman, and the Jerusalem Post reported Trump reversed a plan to charge Strait of Hormuz transit fees.

threads.label: Iranian diplomacy and domestic pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported chief negotiator Ghalibaf and US VP Vance both defending diplomacy backed by strikes, and Foreign Minister Araghchi visiting Doha days after Iran fired missiles at Qatar. A leaked presidency report cited by Iran International recorded record public anger, and a petition signed by nearly 100,000 urged Paydari Front hardliners to visit the southern war zone.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and threats to Trump
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a message saying America has a problem with Iran's "distinct and unyielding identity" and a funeral-related excerpt referring to Iran's slain leader. Iran International reported a new Tehran billboard hinting Trump is "next" after Lindsey Graham's death, and Defa Press claimed the Islamic Resistance of Iraq offered a $10 million bounty to kill Trump.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and UNIFIL
threads.summary: German FM Johann Wadephul proposed an EU-mandated force to replace UNIFIL and allow IDF withdrawal without Hezbollah's return, per the Jerusalem Post. A poll cited by the Post found only 11% of Lebanese believe Hezbollah's weapons improve security, and Syria reported busting a weapons smuggling operation aimed at Hezbollah.

threads.label: Gaza operations and Israeli politics
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas Shati Battalion platoon commander Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq in a northern Gaza strike and destroyed four Hamas weapon depots overnight in central Gaza. Maj.-Gen. Avi Bluth said the IDF controls over 60% of Gaza, and IRIB reported the Knesset approved its own dissolution paving the way for early elections.
